column2: The backup failed, so nothing was changed
column3: 备份失败，因此没有做任何更改

column2: Telling the disk which space is free (fstrim)…
column3: 正在通知磁盘哪些空间空闲（fstrim）…

column2: WSL {version} is newer than the versions WSLPilot was tested with. Everything should work, but please report problems.
column3: WSL {version} 比 WSLPilot 测试过的版本更新。功能应能正常使用，如遇问题请反馈。

column2: WSL Containers come with WSL 3.0 or later. Update WSL to use containers.
column3: WSL 容器随 WSL 3.0 及以后版本提供。更新 WSL 后即可使用容器。
{total:int} 个容器中有 {running:int} 个在运行

column2: Every running distribution stops and unsaved work in it is lost. WSL containers keep running.
column3: 所有运行中的发行版都会停止，其中未保存的工作将丢失。WSL 容器会继续运行。

column2: Install one from the list, or import a backup or a tar file.
column3: 从列表中安装一个，或导入备份或 tar 文件。

column2: Up to {size} can be reclaimed by compacting
The distribution stops. Converting can take a long time for large distributions.
column3: 发行版会停止。较大的发行版转换可能需要很长时间。

column2: WSL stops the distribution and shrinks its virtual disk to the space actually used.
column3: WSL 会停止该发行版，并将其虚拟磁盘缩小到实际使用的空间。

column2: This WSL version cannot compact by itself. WSLPilot shuts down all of WSL and runs diskpart in a separate administrator window.
column3: 当前 WSL 版本无法自行压缩。WSLPilot 会关闭整个 WSL，并在单独的管理员窗口中运行 diskpart。

column2: WSL moves the virtual disk to the new folder. The distribution stops first.
column3: WSL 会把虚拟磁盘移动到新目录。发行版会先停止。

column2: The maximum size the disk may grow to, such as 256GB. The distribution stops first.
column3: 磁盘可增长到的最大大小，例如 256GB。发行版会先停止。

column2: A sparse disk shrinks by itself when files are deleted. WSL marks this as experimental.
column3: 稀疏磁盘会在删除文件后自行缩小。WSL 将其标记为实验性功能。

column2: The distribution and its disk are deleted. This cannot be undone without a backup.
column3: 发行版及其磁盘会被删除。没有备份就无法恢复。

column2: Download from the internet instead of the Microsoft Store
column3: 从互联网下载，而不是从 Microsoft Store

column3: tar 文件（来自 wsl --export 或根文件系统）或 .vhdx 磁盘将成为一个新的发行版。

column2: The file is a virtual disk (.vhdx)
The distribution stops first, so the copy is consistent.
column3: 发行版会先停止，以保证副本一致。

column2: Only lines you change are rewritten. The file is backed up before saving.
column3: 只会重写你修改的行。保存前会备份文件。

column3: 文件尚不存在：所有设置均为默认值。保存时会创建它。

column3: 文件中的其它设置（保持不变）：{keys}

column3: 替换前会备份当前文件。

column2: Takes effect when {name} restarts (stop it, or wait about 8 seconds after its last window closes).
column3: 在 {name} 重新启动后生效（停止它，或在最后一个窗口关闭约 8 秒后）。

column2: Takes effect when the container session restarts.
column3: 在容器 session 重新启动后生效。

column2: Start systemd as the init process (WSL 2).
column3: 以 systemd 作为 init 进程启动（WSL 2）。

column3: 发行版启动时以 root 运行。

column2: Mount the file systems listed in /etc/fstab at start.
column3: 启动时挂载 /etc/fstab 中列出的文件系统。

column2: Keep the time zone in step with Windows.
column3: 与 Windows 时区保持同步。

column2: Let Linux programs use the Windows GPU.
column3: 允许 Linux 程序使用 Windows GPU。

column2: Memory for the WSL 2 virtual machine, such as 8GB. Default: half of the computer's memory.
column3: WSL 2 虚拟机的内存，例如 8GB。默认：电脑内存的一半。

column2: Swap size, 0 for none. Default: a quarter of memory.
column3: 交换区大小，0 表示不使用。默认：内存的四分之一。

column2: nat shares the PC's address; mirrored gives Linux the same addresses as Windows.
column3: nat 共享电脑的地址；mirrored 让 Linux 使用与 Windows 相同的地址。

column2: Reach Linux servers at localhost from Windows.
column3: 在 Windows 上通过 localhost 访问 Linux 服务。
通过 Windows 解析域名。

column2: Apply firewall rules to WSL traffic.
column3: 对 WSL 流量应用防火墙规则。

column2: Pass the Windows HTTP proxy to Linux.
column3: 将 Windows HTTP 代理传给 Linux。
支持 Linux 图形程序（WSLg）。
允许在 WSL 中运行虚拟机。

column2: How long the VM stays on with nothing running.
column3: 没有任何程序运行时虚拟机保持开启的时长。

column2: Maximum size of new distribution disks, such as 512GB.
column3: 新发行版磁盘的最大大小，例如 512GB。

column2: Path of a custom Linux kernel.
column3: 自定义 Linux 内核的路径。

column2: How cached memory goes back to Windows.
column3: 缓存内存返还给 Windows 的方式。
新磁盘自动回收空间（实验性）。

column2: In mirrored mode, reach Windows through its own addresses.
column3: 在 mirrored 模式下，通过 Windows 自己的地址访问它。

column2: Processors for the container session. Default: all.
column3: 容器 session 的处理器数量。默认：全部。

column2: Memory for the container session, such as 8GB. Default: half.
column3: 容器 session 的内存，例如 8GB。默认：一半。

column2: Maximum size of the images and containers disk.
column3: 镜像与容器磁盘的最大大小。

column2: Changing it does not move existing images or containers: a new, empty session starts there.
column3: 修改它不会移动已有的镜像与容器：会在新位置启动一个空的 session。

column2: 0.0.0.0 makes published ports reachable from other computers.
column3: 0.0.0.0 让其它电脑也能访问已发布的端口。

column2: Name containers use to reach Windows; none to disable.
column3: 容器访问 Windows 时使用的名称；none 表示禁用。

column2: Seconds the session stays on when idle.
column3: 空闲时 session 保持开启的秒数。

column2: wincred uses Windows Credential Manager; file uses an encrypted file.
column3: wincred 使用 Windows 凭据管理器；file 使用加密文件。

column2: host:container, separated by commas. Ports bind to 127.0.0.1 unless an address is given.
column3: host:container，以逗号分隔。未指定地址时绑定到 127.0.0.1。

column2: One per line: volume:/path or C:\folder:/path, add :ro for read-only.
column3: 每行一个：volume:/path 或 C:\folder:/path，追加 :ro 表示只读。

column2: WSL Containers cannot restart containers itself; the WSLPilot agent does it while you are signed in.
column3: WSL 容器本身不能重启容器；在你登录期间由 WSLPilot agent 执行。

column3: 容器会被删除。命名 Volume 会保留。

column3: 所有已停止的容器都会被删除，包括在 WSLPilot 之外创建的。

column2: Dangling images that no container uses are deleted.
column3: 没有容器使用的悬空镜像会被删除。

column2: The image is deleted. Images in use by a container are not removed.
column3: 镜像会被删除。被容器使用的镜像不会删除。

column3: 连接到它的容器会失去这个网络。

column2: Files move in and out of volumes as tar, unpacked inside Linux, so owners, permissions and links are kept.
column3: 文件以 tar 形式进出 Volume，在 Linux 内解包，因此属主、权限与链接都会保留。

column2: guest keeps data in the session's disk; vhd gives the volume its own virtual disk of a fixed size.
column3: guest 把数据保存在 session 的磁盘中；vhd 为 Volume 提供一个固定大小的独立虚拟磁盘。

column2: Everything in the volume is replaced. A safety backup is made first.
column3: Volume 中的全部内容会被替换。会先进行安全备份。

column2: The archive is unpacked by tar inside a helper container; nothing is unpacked on Windows.
column3: 归档由辅助容器内的 tar 解包；不会在 Windows 上解包。

column2: Stop containers that write to the volume first for a consistent copy.
column3: 为获得一致的副本，请先停止写入该 Volume 的容器。

column2: {count:int} entries imported; {found:int} found in the volume
column3: 已导入 {count:int} 个条目；Volume 中共有 {found:int} 个

column2: The volume and all its data are deleted.
column3: Volume 及其全部数据会被删除。

column2: All containers stop while the container session is restarted, then diskpart runs in a separate administrator window.
column3: 容器 session 重启期间所有容器都会停止，然后 diskpart 会在单独的管理员窗口中运行。

column2: Choose a compose.yaml. It stays where it is; WSLPilot only remembers where it is.
column3: 选择一个 compose.yaml。文件留在原处；WSLPilot 只记住它的位置。

column2: Projects run on a backend chosen when they are added. A project never moves to another backend by itself.
column3: 项目运行在添加时选定的 Backend 上。项目绝不会自行切换到其它 Backend。

column2: The project's containers and networks are removed. Volumes are kept unless you choose otherwise.
column3: 项目的容器与网络会被删除。除非你另行选择，Volume 会保留。

column2: The data in the volumes is deleted.
column3: Volume 中的数据会被删除。

column2: The WSLPilot agent brings the project up when you sign in.
column3: 登录时由 WSLPilot agent 启动该项目。

column2: The project is valid for this backend.
WSLPilot forgets the project. Its files, containers and volumes are not touched.
column3: WSLPilot 会忘记该项目。其文件、容器与 Volume 不受影响。

column2: Everything restorable from every location, including backups from other computers and plain tar files. Outside locations are read-only.
column3: 列出所有位置中可恢复的内容，包括其它电脑的备份与普通 tar 文件。外部位置为只读。

column2: Not made by WSLPilot: where it came from and whether it was consistent are unknown.
column3: 非 WSLPilot 生成：来源与是否一致均无法确认。

column2: A disk image restores only as a new distribution.
column3: 磁盘镜像只能恢复为新的发行版。

column2: The backup failed its check, so nothing was restored
column3: 备份未通过校验，因此没有恢复任何内容

column2: Files keep their owners and permissions. Existing files with the same names are overwritten.
column3: 文件保留属主与权限。同名的已有文件会被覆盖。

column2: The current state is backed up first, then replaced by this backup.
column3: 会先备份当前状态，然后用此备份替换。

column2: The backup files are deleted from this location.
column3: 备份文件会从此位置删除。

column2: Plans make backups on a schedule. Backups stay restorable even after a plan is deleted.
column3: 计划按时间表生成备份。删除计划后备份依然可以恢复。

column2: Plans only run while WSLPilot is open: the background agent is not installed.
column3: 计划只会在 WSLPilot 打开时运行：后台 agent 未安装。

column2: The plan stops. The backups it made are kept.
column3: 计划会停止。它生成的备份会保留。

column2: Incremental stores only what changed; archive keeps one file per backup; folder stays browsable in Explorer.
column3: 增量只保存变化的部分；归档每次备份一个文件；目录可在资源管理器中浏览。

column2: By default running distributions and containers stop for a consistent copy and start again afterwards.
column3: 默认情况下，运行中的发行版与容器会先停止以获得一致的副本，结束后再启动。

column2: Choose at least one thing to back up.
column3: 至少选择一项备份内容。

column2: Manual and safety backups go here.
column3: 手动备份与安全备份保存在这里。

column2: Runs backup plans, restart policies and Compose autostart while the window is closed, as you, without administrator rights.
column3: 在窗口关闭时以你的身份运行备份计划、重启策略与 Compose 自启，无需管理员权限。

column2: Every running container stops; the next command starts a new session with the saved settings.
column3: 所有运行中的容器都会停止；下一条命令会用保存的设置启动新的 session。

column2: Manages WSL distributions, WSL Containers, Compose projects and backups. Licensed under GPL-3.0.

column2: No backups found yet. Back something up, or open a folder or archive from another computer.
column3: 还没有找到备份。可以先备份，或打开来自其它电脑的目录或归档。

column2: Images and volumes move to another folder or drive.
column3: 镜像与 Volume 会移动到其它目录或驱动器。

column2: All containers stop. Images and volumes are exported, the storage folder is changed and they are imported again. Containers themselves are not moved and must be created again (Compose projects: Up). The old data stays where it is until you delete it.
column3: 所有容器都会停止。镜像与 Volume 会被导出，存储目录修改后再导入。容器本身不会迁移，需要重新创建（Compose 项目：执行 up）。旧数据会保留在原处，直到你删除它。

column2: Moved {images:int} images and {volumes:int} volumes. Create these containers again: {containers}. Exported copies: {staging}
column3: 已迁移 {images:int} 个镜像与 {volumes:int} 个 Volume。请重新创建这些容器：{containers}。导出的副本：{staging}

column2: A container cannot be changed in place: it is replaced by a new one with these settings. Volumes are kept; files written inside the container itself are lost.
column3: 容器无法原地修改：会用这些设置创建新容器来替换它。Volume 会保留；写在容器自身内部的文件会丢失。

column2: native keeps data in a WSL Containers volume; bind uses a Windows folder instead.
column3: native 把数据保存在 WSL 容器的 Volume 中；bind 改用一个 Windows 目录。

column2: Existing data is not moved between a volume and a folder. Back the volume up first if it holds data.
column3: 已有数据不会在 Volume 与目录之间移动。如果 Volume 中有数据，请先备份。

column2: Updates are signed and downloaded from the GitHub releases of WSLPilot. The installed app updates itself; a portable copy cannot.
column3: 更新经过签名，从 WSLPilot 的 GitHub Releases 下载。安装版会自行更新；便携版不能。

column2: Volume import, export and backups run tar in a short-lived container of this image. It needs tar with -p and --numeric-owner. Empty uses alpine:3.20.
column3: Volume 的导入、导出与备份会在此镜像的临时容器中运行 tar。镜像中的 tar 需支持 -p 与 --numeric-owner。留空则使用 alpine:3.20。

column2: Encrypt the repository with a password
Applies when the repository is created; an existing repository keeps its setting. The password is kept for this Windows account only (DPAPI). Losing it loses the backups.
column3: 在创建仓库时生效；已有仓库保持原设置。密码只为当前 Windows 账户保存（DPAPI）。丢失密码即丢失备份。
